SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C.S. 6, Special Branch Bureau.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. D. REGISTRY 7516）
Date Aug. 18th 1936.

Subject Reference the attached letter dated 13.8.36 from Mrs. Cooke, 427
Yu Yuen Road, on the subject of P.J. Melcer.

Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Golder.

Relative to the above matter I have to state as
follows :-
Mrs. Cooke is a British subject or at least she
claims such status in which case her only redress at law is
to sue P.J. Melcer by civil process.
As to the property remaining in her possession
and which was detained by her predecessor, boarding house
keepers have no legal right under British law to detain
anything which is the property of a boarder in lieu of debt.
Boarding house keepers have the right to refuse shelter or
accommodation to anyone or to enter an agreement as to charges
with each individual and in view of this are denied the power
to detain property allowed the ordinary inn keeper.

（批：P.A. Crime.
Sir! Cooke
informed as
spoken

报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特务科登记处 7516）
日期：1936年8月18日。

事由：关于附呈的库克夫人（Mrs. Cooke，住愚园路427号）于1936年8月13日来信，涉及P.J. Melcer一事。

由副督察戈尔德（Golder）撰写并转呈。

就上述事项，本人陈述如下：
库克夫人为英国臣民，或至少她声称拥有此身份；在此情况下，她唯一的法律救济途径是通过民事诉讼程序起诉P.J. Melcer。
至于仍由其占有且被其前任扣留的财产，根据英国法律，寄宿公寓经营者无权扣留寄宿者的任何财产以抵偿债务。
寄宿公寓经营者有权拒绝向任何人提供住所或住宿，或与每个人就费用达成协议；鉴于此，他们不被赋予普通旅馆老板所享有的扣留财产的权力。

（批注：警务助理专员 刑事科。

ALSA LODGE
427 YU YUEN ROAD
TEL. 22091
SHANGHAI.

Mrs Coore has just taken over the
management of the above address, & she
would like to draw the attention of the
Police to one - P.J. Helen, employed by the
Crown Life Ins: Co. at 113 Hupeihuang Rd -
This man stayed at "Alsa Lodge" from
Sept: 2nd /35 - till Oct 12th - 39 days - when he
tried to get away with his luggage, without
paying his bill - He owes $120.00 , & Mrs Coore
holds a pge. & four trunks of his, & does
not quite know what to do in the
matter - She has written repeated requests
for a settlement of this a/c, which have
been ignored - Therefore she is reporting the
man to the Police, as he appears to be
a very undesirable character -
Mrs Coore would appreciate it very
much if the Police would take this
matter up - C.L. x hu als o D 84, ...

August 13th /36. （印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 15 ... (CRIME BRANCH)）

阿尔萨旅舍（ALSA LODGE）
愚园路427号
电话：22091
上海。

库尔夫人（Mrs Coore）刚刚接管上述地址的管理工作，她希望提请警方注意一名叫P.J. Helen的男子，该男子受雇于湖北路113号的皇冠人寿保险公司（Crown Life Ins: Co.）——
此人于1935年9月2日至10月12日期间住在“阿尔萨旅舍”，共39天，当时他试图在不结清账单的情况下携带行李离开——他欠款120.00美元，库尔夫人持有他的一张页面（原文如此，疑为page之误）和四个手提箱，对于此事该如何处理她不太清楚——她已多次写信要求结算此账目，但均被无视——因此，她向警方举报此人，因为他似乎是一个非常不受欢迎的人物——
如果警方能介入处理此事，库尔夫人将不胜感激—— C.L. x hu als o D 84, ...

1936年8月13日。（印：副总巡官 15 ... （刑事科））
